name: Running Pace Calculator
description: Calculate running pace per kilometer and mile, race finish time, splits, and running speed for any distance from 5K to marathon.
search_intent: Calculate running pace per km or mile and predict race completion times.
keywords: min per km to min per mile

inputs.label: Distance preset or custom
inputs.help: 5k, 10k, half-marathon (21.0975 km), marathon (42.195 km), or custom distance

calculation: Total time in seconds = (hours × 3600) + (minutes × 60) + seconds. Distance in miles = distanceKm / 1.609344. Pace seconds per km = totalSeconds / distanceKm. Pace seconds per mile = totalSeconds / distanceMiles. Format pace as MM:SS. Speed in km/h = (distanceKm / totalSeconds) × 3600. Speed in mph = (distanceMiles / totalSeconds) × 3600. Equivalent race times use Pete Riegel's standard endurance formula: T2 = T1 × (D2 / D1)^1.06.
limitations: Race projections using Riegel formula assume equivalent endurance training and course topography.
Elevation changes, temperature, humidity, and pacing strategy significantly affect actual race execution.
Does not replace individual cardiovascular training programming.
